# dayloop v0.12.0-rc1 — Phase 17 test build

This prerelease is for hands-on testing after Phase 17 and before Phase 18 release hardening.

## What to test

- **Cold start / saved skin:** returning users should open directly into the saved pack skin without an engine-look or onboarding flash.
- **Home-screen widget:** engine, angular/ribbon, glass, and framed/plaque treatments should preserve the same title/date, completion count, and next-deadline information across supported widget sizes.
- **Launcher treatment:** packs with a `launcherBadge` publish the Dayloop-owned dynamic shortcut with the small pack motif; the primary installed-app icon remains Dayloop-owned.
- **Existing Phase 16 behavior:** skin motion, haptics, optional sounds, Today answer cards, and daily completion behavior should still work normally.
- **Pack switching:** switching packs in-session should continue to re-skin without returning to the startup gate.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It is built from the `candidate` variant using Android's standard debug signing key.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production-signed v0.11.1 app.
- Because it is a separate application id, its profiles/progress/settings are separate from the stable app. Use it for visual/behavior testing rather than migration testing.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc1` (`versionCode 14`).

Phase 18 will own screenshot goldens, budgets, animated WebP conversion, strip-art, macrobenchmark gates, and final production release hardening.

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
